scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/trui/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/federation/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:headers && npm run check:terms && npm run check:structure && npm run check:icons && npm run check:api
scripts.catalog:build: storybook build -o dist/catalog && npm run docs:api
scripts.check:api: npm run build && npm -w @tim-riep/trui run api
scripts.api:update: npm run build && npm -w @tim-riep/trui run api:update
scripts.test:visual: npm run catalog:build && docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.65.0-noble npx playwright test -c playwright.visual.config.ts
scripts.test:visual:update: npm run catalog:build && docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.65.0-noble npx playwright test -c playwright.visual.config.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.build:package:catalog: npm run build:browser && npm run catalog:build && node scripts/build-package.mjs --with-catalog
